ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This is a blended format course containing online weekly sessions via elluminate (www.elluminate.com) and live meeting sessions for six labs at the Morton Arboretum in Lisle, IL. Lab dates are: 9/6, 9/27, 10/4, 10/11, 11/1, 11/15 from 10am to 2:30 PM CST. Students will be required to have high speed internet, working microphone and speakers for this course.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign AO Fees 2+4 $41.00 per Bill Hour, and Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign AO Tuition 2+4 $305.00 per Bill Hour.
